id: title:CShine612:accept uuidt ids on push step message category

observations.behavior: Removes UUID validation from `message_category_id` and `template_uuid` fields.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows workflow action configuration to use non-standard or missing identifiers without schema rejection; could support broader compatibility but also risks invalid IDs reaching downstream execution.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case expecting valid UUIDs for these previously optional-but-now-unvalidated fields.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests that workflows can be configured with arbitrary strings rather than strict UUIDs, potentially changing runtime behavior compared to prior expectations.

observations.behavior: Changes both fields from requiring valid UUID format to accepting any string or omitting them.
observations.posthog_connection: Relaxes input constraints on push-notification templates, possibly allowing malformed references while removing checks against PostHog's identity system.
